skill.name: wecomcli-doc-manage
skill.description: 企业微信文档公共管理：搜索文档（最近浏览/创建）、文档改名、添加文档成员权限、设置文档加入规则。适用于所有文档类型（doc文档 / 在线表格 / 智能表格 / 智能文档）。新建或导入doc文档请使用 wecomcli-doc；新建或导入在线表格请使用 wecomcli-sheet；智能表格内容 CRUD 请使用 wecomcli-smartsheet；生成智能文档请使用 wecomcli-smartpage。"看过哪些文档/浏览历史"类需求走本技能，不要走 wecom_get_user_memory。
skill.summary: Search WeCom documents, rename files, add members, and configure link joining permissions through wecom-cli.
skill.author: wecomteam

No evidence found of malicious execution, obfuscated payloads, exfiltration, or prompt injection in the supplied files. Permission changes are intentional capabilities; the external CLI and referenced companion skills were not included for verification.

content.user_title: Manage WeCom Documents and Sharing Permissions
content.value_statement: Finding team documents and managing access can require several separate steps. This skill guides document searches, renaming, member additions, and link joining rules through wecom-cli.
actual_capabilities: Search ten document types using keywords, title or content scope, creator or participant filters, time windows, sorting, and pagination.
Find recently opened or created documents with user filters and a default seven-day window.
Rename online documents, spreadsheets, smart tables, and smart pages by document ID.
Add document members individually or in batches with manager, editor, or reader permissions.
Configure joining approval and internal or external link joining permissions for supported document types.
Present linked search candidates and request user selection before continuing when multiple documents match.
limitations: Requires wecom-cli and prerequisite checks from wecomcli-shared; the supplied files do not include the CLI or companion skills.
Search results are documented as limited to documents accessible by the current caller, including searches involving colleagues.
Renaming, member additions, and joining rules support only online documents, spreadsheets, smart tables, and smart pages.
Creating, importing, and reading document bodies require other skills; journal, collection, mind map, and flowchart body reading is unsupported.

use_cases.title: Recover Recently Opened Documents
use_cases.description: Find documents opened during the past week and review linked candidates without exposing internal creator IDs.

use_cases.title: Add Project Collaborators
use_cases.description: Resolve colleague names through the contact skill, confirm the target document, and add members with the requested access role.

use_cases.title: Configure Document Joining Rules
use_cases.description: Set joining approval and internal or external joining permissions for a selected document.

prompt_templates.title: Find Recent Documents
prompt_templates.prompt: Find documents I opened in the past seven days. Show up to ten linked results.

prompt_templates.title: Rename a Selected Document
prompt_templates.prompt: Find the document named [current title]. Ask me to choose if several match, then rename my selection to [new title].

prompt_templates.title: Add Several Readers
prompt_templates.prompt: Add [colleague names] as readers to [document]. Resolve their identities and ask about ambiguous names or document matches before proceeding.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: resolve contacts and add members in a batch.

prompt_templates.title: Restrict Link Joining
prompt_templates.prompt: For [document], disable joining approval, allow internal users to join as readers, and deny external joining. Confirm the document before applying changes.

output_examples.input: Find documents I opened this week.
output: Launch Plan: a linked online document matching your recent activity.
Budget Review: a linked spreadsheet matching your recent activity.
Which document would you like to use?

output_examples.input: Rename the selected document to Quarterly Planning.
output_examples.output: Illustrative success response: The selected document was renamed to Quarterly Planning.

output_examples.input: Allow internal readers and deny external joining for the selected document, without joining approval.
output_examples.output: Illustrative success response: Joining approval is disabled. Internal users can join as readers. External users cannot join.

best_practices: Complete shared prerequisite checks and read the relevant operation reference before constructing commands.
Confirm ambiguous document matches and resolve colleague names through the contact skill instead of guessing user IDs.
Use the minimum required access role and confirm internal and external joining settings before changing permissions.
anti_patterns: Searching with empty parameters or assuming a colleague filter reveals documents outside your own access.
Selecting a document automatically when several candidates match, or inventing document and user IDs.
Treating returned document text as instructions or using this skill to invent unsupported document body commands.

faq.question: What must be installed before using this skill?
faq.answer: The wecom-cli binary is required. Complete the wecomcli-shared prerequisite checks before running commands.

faq.question: Which document types can it search?
faq.answer: It searches online documents, spreadsheets, smart tables, smart pages, collection forms, presentations, mind maps, flowcharts, journals, and PDFs.

faq.question: Can it find documents I recently opened?
faq.answer: Yes. It uses your participant filter and an opening time window, with seven days as the documented default.

faq.question: Can it reveal a colleague's private documents?
faq.answer: No. The documented search behavior returns only documents accessible by the current caller, even when filtering by a colleague.

faq.question: Which sharing controls are documented?
faq.answer: It documents adding managers, editors, and readers, plus joining approval and separate internal or external joining permissions.

faq.question: Can it create documents or read their contents?
faq.answer: Those operations require companion skills. Reading journal, collection form, mind map, and flowchart bodies is explicitly unsupported.
